sourceDecision: Retain production. decimal declares n/u/m/k/K/M/G/T/P/E factors. quantityNumber accepts unknown and declares finite number passthrough, non-string null, then one anchored signed decimal pattern with optional exponent, binary-unit or decimal-unit suffix. No trim or normalization call is declared. Missing match returns null; suffix defaults to the empty string. The factor expression declares bare factor1, exponent10**Number(suffix.slice(1)) behind its e/E length and non-i guard, binary1024**("KMGTPE".indexOf(suffix[0])+1), otherwise decimal[suffix]. It multiplies Number(match[1]) by factor and returns only a finite result. scalar declares the existing null/undefined/empty/"-"/"unknown" precheck before exact kind==="quantity" delegation. These are literal declarations, not evaluated parsing values, numeric precision, unit compatibility or runtime ordering. The accepted193-line tests/query-store.test.ts imports the real table-sort helper. Its targeted saved source declares a quantity sort assertion over2Gi/512Mi/1Gi and direct250m/1.5e3/broken/1Ei assertions; they were read, never invoked, and establish no current result or exhaustive grammar coverage. Public caller labels/keys/IDs/projections, comparator/direction/tie-breaker,100-row slice, filters/cursors and query/session/freshness/capability/navigation gates remain unchanged. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
